lines.en: label dormwartwo17:
scene secondcostumecontest1
: I will stop by the hardware store tomorrow.
lines.zh: : 我明天会顺路去一趟五金店。

lines.en: : You’re damn right you will.
lines.zh: : 你最好是这样。

lines.en: : Hey, how did the contest go?
lines.zh: : 嘿，比赛怎么样了？

lines.en: : Futaba, do you think we’ve been growing distant at all lately?
lines.zh: : Futaba，你觉得我们最近是不是变得越来越疏远了？

lines.en: scene secondcostumecontest2
: Well, I guess that answers {i}that{/i} question.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我想这就回答了{i}那个{/i}问题。

lines.en: : Seriously, though. If somebody like...I don’t know- {i}Uta{/i} came along and suddenly knew more about you than I did, how would that make you feel?
lines.zh: : 不过说真的。如果有个……比如说 {i}Uta{/i} 之类的人突然出现，比我还了解你，你会是什么感觉？

lines.en: : Umm...shocked. I haven’t really spoken much to Uta. Especially not compared to somebody like you or Nodoka.
lines.zh: : 嗯……震惊吧。我和 Uta 其实没怎么说过话。尤其是跟你或 Nodoka 比起来。

lines.en: : Did Yasu...somehow beat you at the Sensei trivia contest thing?
lines.zh: : Yasu 是不是……在那场老师知识问答里赢了你？

lines.en: scene secondcostumecontest3

: Yes! But before you tell me it’s not a big deal and that it’s just a stupid contest and that it doesn’t matter to me who puts what in my vagina, please understand that I am very sensitive about this!
lines.zh: : 没错！但在你告诉我这没什么大不了、那只是个愚蠢的比赛、以及谁把什么放进我的阴道对我来说无所谓之前，请先理解——我对这件事非常敏感！

lines.en: : Of course it’s a big deal. I know how much Sensei means to you and-
lines.zh: : 这当然是大件事。我知道老师对你来说有多重要，而且——

lines.en: scene secondcostumecontest4
: Wait, what was that last part?
lines.zh: : 等等，最后那句是什么？

lines.en: : I’m very sensitive!
lines.zh: : 我非常敏感！

lines.en: : The...other last...You know what? That doesn’t matter.
lines.zh: : 是……倒数第二句……算了，不重要。

lines.en: : I’m not going to hold it against you for getting upset about this. But I don’t think just losing a contest is enough to make your relationship with Sensei...devoid of all meaning.
lines.zh: : 我不会因为你为这事难过就怪你。但我觉得，光是输掉一场比赛，还不足以让你和老师的关系变得……毫无意义。

lines.en: scene secondcostumecontest5
: It’s not {i}just{/i} that, though. We had a whole talk recently about how the two of us aren’t as close as we once were, and it’s really starting to get to me the more I think about it.
lines.zh: : 可{i}不只是{/i}这样。我们最近好好谈过一次，说我们俩已经不像从前那么亲近了，而我越想越难受。

lines.en: : Then why not just...spend more time with him?
lines.zh: : 那为什么不干脆……多花点时间陪他？

lines.en: : Because I can’t even look at him without Otoha getting all self-conscious and thinking she’s just the latest trend for me. And I can’t ignore Sensei because he’ll just think I don’t care anymore.
lines.zh: : 因为我看他一眼，Otoha 就会变得特别不自在，觉得她对我来说不过是最新一波的潮流。而我又不能无视老师，因为那样他只会觉得我不再在乎他了。

lines.en: : I think Sensei is smarter than that, Rin.
lines.zh: : 我觉得老师比那更聪明，Rin。

lines.en: : Yeah, well, you probably know more about him than I do at this point too. So I’ll just have to take your word for it.
lines.zh: : 是吗，哼，大概连你对他的了解都比我现在多了。那我就姑且信你一回吧。

lines.en: scene secondcostumecontest6
: I’m assuming this...unexpected turn of events also has something to do with the fact that...Otoha didn’t come back with you?
lines.zh: : 我猜这……突如其来的变故，也和 Otoha 没跟你一起回来有关吧？

lines.en: : You assume correctly. Now, please excuse me while I drown my worries away with thirty-seven Shirley Temples at the bar.
lines.zh: : 你猜对了。那么失陪了，我要去吧台用三十七杯秀兰邓波儿把烦恼淹死。

lines.en: : How about I join you and...we can talk it out while I also prevent you from getting diabetes?
lines.zh: : 我陪你一起去怎么样……我们可以边聊边说开，顺便还能防止你得糖尿病？

lines.en: : Thanks, Futaba. No one else ever tries to prevent me from getting diabetes.
lines.zh: : 谢谢，Futaba。从来没别人试着防止我得糖尿病。

lines.en: : That’s...what I’m here for.
lines.zh: : 这……就是我的职责所在。

lines.en: scene black
scene secondcostumecontest7
: Hey...do you...need any help with anything?...
lines.zh: : 嘿……你……需要帮忙吗？……

lines.en: : Oh, Sana! You’re back. Did you have fun at church?
lines.zh: : 哦，Sana！你回来了。在教堂玩得开心吗？

lines.en: scene secondcostumecontest8
: Uhh...no...
: In fact...I kind of wish I just...stayed here instead...
lines.zh: : 事实上……我倒有点希望自己……干脆留在这儿……

lines.en: : Yeah. That about sums up how I felt the one time I went to a church too.
lines.zh: : 是啊。我唯一一次去教堂时的感受，大概也就是这样。

lines.en: : You don’t have to worry about helping out, though. Go have fun with all of your friends. I’ve got Haruka and Kaori helping out tonight. And Yuki’s starting to get pretty good at this.
lines.zh: : 不过你不用担心帮忙的事。去和朋友们玩吧。今晚有 Haruka 和 Kaori 帮我，Yuki 也渐渐上手了。

lines.en: scene secondcostumecontest9
: Are you sure? There are a lot of people here.
lines.zh: : 你确定吗？这儿人挺多的。

lines.en: : And almost half of them are paying. Isn’t that crazy? It’s a major improvement from last year when I was just giving stuff away.
lines.zh: : 而且差不多有一半人是付钱的。很疯狂吧？比去年我只会白送东西的时候，可是巨大的进步。

lines.en: : I mean...yeah...yeah, that...wasn’t really a good business move.
lines.zh: : 我是说……是啊……是啊，那……确实算不上什么好的经营策略。

lines.en: : And neither was...giving alcohol to high school girls, but...at this rate of...self-improvement, you...might even stop doing that as well...
lines.zh: : 给高中女生灌酒也一样算不上……不过……照这个……自我提升的速度，你……说不定连那个也会戒掉……

lines.en: : Maybe! Depends on profits as I’m currently making back what I lost on you earlier.
lines.zh: : 也许吧！得看收益，毕竟我现在正在把先前在你身上输掉的赚回来。

lines.en: : Please don’t...bet on me anymore...
lines.zh: : 请别……再拿我下注了……

lines.en: : You are my daughter. It’s not like I’m going to bet {i}against{/i} you.
lines.zh: : 你是我女儿。我总不至于{i}押你输{/i}吧。

lines.en: if sarabjwin == True:
scene secondcostumecontest10
: Besides, I already made up for the point you lost earlier. So it’s like nobody ever lost at all!
lines.zh: : 再说了，你之前输掉的那一分我已经补回来了。所以就当谁都没输过！

lines.en: : What? How?
lines.zh: : 什么？怎么做到的？

lines.en: : Oh, you know what? I’ll be right back. I have to talk to Haruka about something.
lines.zh: : 哦，对了。我马上回来。我得跟 Haruka 说点事。

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: scene black
: Mom?
lines.zh: : 妈妈？

lines.en: : How?
lines.zh: : 怎么办到的？

lines.en: else:
: You know you can just...not participate in any betting at all...right?...
lines.zh: : 你知道你其实可以……完全不参加任何打赌……对吧？……

lines.en: scene secondcostumecontest10

: And stay right above the poverty line forever? Not a chance. Mommy’s gonna hit it rich. And if Mommy needs to stake all of her money on her beautiful daughter to do that, that’s what Mommy is going to do.
lines.zh: : 然后永远待在贫困线正上方？想都别想。妈妈我要发大财。如果妈妈需要把全部身家押在自己漂亮的女儿身上才能做到，那妈妈就会这么做。

lines.en: : Can you...stop calling yourself that, please?...It makes me uncomfortable...
lines.zh: : 你能不能……别再那么称呼自己了？……这让我很不舒服……

lines.en: scene black
: I’ll stop when you turn 40. Until then, I’m not changing a thing.
lines.zh: : 等你四十岁我就不叫了。在那之前，我一个字都不会改。

lines.en: : Ugh...
scene secondcostumecontest11
: Jeez. Shit’s really poppin’ off in here and all {i}I{/i} got to do over the last two hours is stand outside, watch some lesbians fight, then ride a bus.
lines.zh: : 天哪。这边可真是炸开锅了，而{i}我{/i}这两个小时里做的全部事情就是站在外面、看几个蕾丝边吵架，然后坐巴士。

lines.en: : Sounds like a normal day in LA to me.
lines.zh: : 听起来跟洛杉矶平常的一天差不多。

lines.en: scene secondcostumecontest12
: The fuck you know about LA? And how come you never invited me?
lines.zh: : 你他妈懂什么洛杉矶？还有，你怎么从来没邀请过我？

lines.en: : Sensei...I’m sorry. I have lost the scavenger hunt and failed at winning your affection. And to Noriko, no less.
lines.zh: : 老师……对不起。我输掉了寻宝游戏，也没能赢得你的宠爱。而且还是输给了 Noriko。

lines.en: scene secondcostumecontest13
: {i}Technically{/i} you lost to Kirin.
lines.zh: : {i}严格来说{/i}你是输给了 Kirin。

lines.en: : Do you think you’re helping? Because that makes it even worse.
lines.zh: : 你觉得你这是在帮我吗？因为这只会让事情更糟。

lines.en: : Mind if I mingle for a bit before kicking off the costume contest? Wanna touch base with the rest of the girl gang before you choose which mini cosplayer you’d rather bang.
lines.zh: : 在服装比赛开场前我去串个场子不介意吧？想在你挑出更想上哪个小 coser 之前，先跟女生帮其他人碰个头。

lines.en: scene secondcostumecontest14
: I’d like to take this opportunity to speak on behalf of my uncle in saying that he has no interest in such a thing.
lines.zh: : 我想借这个机会替我叔叔说一句：他对这种事毫无兴趣。

lines.en: : I’d like to take this opportunity to speak on behalf of myself to say that I do, but only under the most legal of circumstances and that is simply something I will not budge on. Thank you.
lines.zh: : 我想借这个机会替我自己说一句：我确实有兴趣，但仅限于最合法的状况下，而这一点我绝不让步。谢谢。

lines.en: : Can I join your girl gang, Imani?
lines.zh: : 我能加入你们的女生帮吗，Imani？

lines.en: : Depends. You willing to perform the blood oath?
lines.zh: : 看情况。你愿意立血誓吗？

lines.en: : Of course. I was born to perform blood oaths.
lines.zh: : 当然。我生来就是为了立血誓的。

lines.en: : What a strange purpose to have been put on this planet for.
lines.zh: : 被放到这个星球上，就为了这么个奇怪的使命。

lines.en: : But...even if, I’m probably gonna say no. Wakana is in the gang and I’m pretty sure she doesn’t want you around her based on the...well, the fact that she kicked you out of her class.
lines.zh: : 不过……就算你愿意，我大概也会拒绝。Wakana 也在帮里，而且看在……嗯，她把你踢出她班上这一点，我敢肯定她不想让你靠近她。

lines.en: : Also, if you join, Kirin is going to want to join and that would obviously turn into a whole thing because of her-
lines.zh: : 再说，你要是加入，Kirin 肯定也想加入，而那显然会变成一整套麻烦事，因为她——

lines.en: : Innate and unflappable desire to have sex with you?
lines.zh: : 天生且不可动摇的想和你上床的欲望？

lines.en: : Bingo.
lines.zh: : 答对了。

lines.en: : I say we just kill her.
lines.zh: : 我说我们干脆杀了她。

lines.en: scene secondcostumecontest15
: It would be for the best at this point. Miss Imai and Sensei would be protected from her advances, I’d wind up getting the win for the scavenger hunt by default, and Noriko...
lines.zh: : 事到如今这才是最好的选择。Imai 小姐和老师就不用再被她纠缠，我也会自动获得寻宝游戏的胜利，而 Noriko……

lines.en: : I don’t know. Noriko can have her clothes or something. That would be easy.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。Noriko 可以拿走她的衣服什么的。那样也简单。

lines.en: scene secondcostumecontest16
: She {i}does{/i} have a bra I like. And it {i}would{/i} be easy.
lines.zh: : 她{i}确实{/i}有一件我很喜欢的胸罩。而且{i}确实{/i}简单。

lines.en: : Fine. If that’s what it takes for me to get my drink on, you guys can kill Kirin. But if the cops ask, I said no. Capiche?
lines.zh: : 行吧。只要能让我喝上酒，你们要杀 Kirin 随你们。但要是警察问起来，我说的是不行。懂吗？

lines.en: : I’ll call my people once the music dies down. I’m glad we were able to reach an understanding.
lines.zh: : 等音乐小下来我就联系我的人。很高兴我们能达成共识。

lines.en: scene black
scene secondcostumecontest17
: Rin! Hi! It’s me! Not your mom! This looks like fifty feet, right?
lines.zh: : Rin！嗨！是我！不是你妈！这看着大概有五十英尺吧，对吧？

lines.en: : Chika already knows you’re my mom, {i}Mom.{/i} There’s no point in hiding it anymore.
lines.zh: : Chika 早就知道你是我妈了，{i}妈{/i}。再藏着也没意义了。

lines.en: : Also, here’s a question- why are you two together?
lines.zh: : 还有，问个问题——你们俩怎么会凑在一起？

lines.en: if chikalust25 == True:
: And why does Chika smell different?
lines.zh: : 还有为什么 Chika 身上的味道不一样了？

lines.en: scene secondcostumecontest18
: Hahah...beats me.
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈……谁知道呢。

lines.en: : You remember how she smells?
lines.zh: : 你记得她身上的味道？

lines.en: : Yes. But only because her locker was next to mine for a long time. Not because I used to sniff her hair when she wasn’t looking or anything. That would be weird.
lines.zh: : 记得。但只是因为她的储物柜以前一直在我旁边。不是因为我趁她不注意偷闻她头发什么的。那也太怪了。

lines.en: : I don’t think it would be that weird.
lines.zh: : 我觉得那也没那么怪。

lines.en: : No...it would be pretty weird.
lines.zh: : 不……那确实挺怪的。

lines.en: else:
: And why are you dressed in spandex? Aren’t you too old for that?
lines.zh: : 还有你为什么穿成紧身衣这样？你穿这个不嫌太老了吗？

lines.en: scene secondcostumecontest19
: You’re never too old for spandex!
lines.zh: : 穿紧身衣永远不会嫌老！

lines.en: : That is just demonstrably untrue.
lines.zh: : 这明显不是事实。

lines.en: scene secondcostumecontest20
: Anyway, I just figured I’d hang out with your mom while I wait for you and Otoha to get back since...Yumi obviously isn’t coming.
lines.zh: : 总之，我想着在等你和 Otoha 回来之前，先和你妈待一会儿，因为……Yumi 显然是不会来了。

lines.en: : I...do not know how I feel about that.
lines.zh: : 我……不知道该对这事作何感想。

lines.en: : Where is she, by the way? Otoha, I mean. I think our class is going to start casting their votes for the popularity poll soon.
lines.zh: : 顺便问一句，她在哪儿？我是说 Otoha。我觉得我们班很快就要开始投人气票了。

lines.en: : The adults, too. I promised Chika I’d vote for her if she didn’t tell anybody she knew where I was living right now. Which definitely isn’t your room.
lines.zh: : 大人们也要投。我答应过 Chika，只要她不告诉别人她知道我现在住哪儿，我就投她。而那个地方绝对不是你的房间。

lines.en: : I came by looking for band recommendations the other day since I want to try listening to more of the stuff you guys do.
lines.zh: : 前几天我顺路过来打听乐队推荐，因为我想多听听你们听的那种东西。

lines.en: : Mom, you have to vote for my girlfriend. It wouldn’t be right if you voted for Chika.
lines.zh: : 妈，你得投给我女朋友。你要是投给 Chika 就不对了。

lines.en: : But your girlfriend isn’t even here.
lines.zh: : 可你女朋友根本不在这儿。

lines.en: : Yeah, because we got into a fight.
lines.zh: : 是啊，因为我们吵架了。

lines.en: scene secondcostumecontest21
: You did? Over what? What happened?
lines.zh: : 真的吗？为了什么？发生什么事了？

lines.en: : I don’t really want to talk about it right now. I just want to hang out and take my mind off of it.
lines.zh: : 我现在不太想谈这个。我只是想玩玩，把这件事从脑子里赶出去。

lines.en: scene secondcostumecontest22
: Hey! I can help with that! I’m basically an expert at pretending failing relationships are still going strong!
lines.zh: : 嘿！这个我能帮上忙！我基本上算是「假装一段快完蛋的感情还好好地」的专家了！

lines.en: : Thanks, Mom. That’s exactly what I wanted to hear.
lines.zh: : 谢了，妈。这正是我想听的话。

lines.en: : I figured! Great news, right?!
lines.zh: : 我就知道！好消息吧？！

lines.en: : Hey, cheer up. I’m sure things will go back to normal in no time at all.
lines.zh: : 嘿，振作点。我敢肯定事情很快就会恢复正常的。

lines.en: scene secondcostumecontest23
: Besides, you’ll have {i}me{/i} in the meantime. And I’m not just saying that because I want you to vote for me. {size=15}But you should totally vote for me.{/size}
lines.zh: : 再说，这段时间你还有{i}我{/i}陪着。而且我这么说也不只是为了让你投我。{size=15}不过你绝对该投我。{/size}

lines.en: : Uh...th...thank you?
lines.zh: : 呃……谢……谢谢？

lines.en: : Man, I wish I had a friend who was that caring. Or any friends at all. Or a girlfriend. Or a life.
lines.zh: : 唉，真希望我也有个这么体贴的朋友。或者有任何朋友也行。或者有个女朋友。或者有个生活。

lines.en: : Or anything, really.
lines.zh: : 或者随便什么，真的。

lines.en: : But hey, at least I’ve got a beer.
lines.zh: : 不过嘿，至少我还有杯啤酒。

lines.en: scene secondcostumecontest24
: Just don’t drink too much or you’ll have even more problems on your hands. Pretty much everything is better in moderation with...only one exception I can think of but can’t talk about.
lines.zh: : 别喝太多就行，不然你手上的麻烦只会更多。基本上什么都是适量最好……只有一个例外，不过我不能说。

lines.en: : Sour Skittles?
lines.zh: : 酸味彩虹糖？

lines.en: : Yes, Rika. Exactly that.
lines.zh: : 对，Rika。就是这个。

lines.en: : Well said, Chika. I knew I-
lines.zh: : 说得好，Chika。我就知道我——

lines.en: scene secondcostumecontest25
: Ooh! Holy shit! Our names rhyme! How cool is that?!
lines.zh: : 哦！我操！我们的名字押韵！这也太酷了吧？！

lines.en: : Really cool! The...coolest thing I’ve heard all night.
lines.zh: : 超酷！是……我整晚听过最酷的事。

lines.en: : Right? Who even needs Otoha when we’ve got the Rika-Chika duo? She’d only drag us down anyway.
lines.zh: : 对吧？有了 Rika-Chika 二人组，谁还需要 Otoha 啊？反正她只会拖我们后腿。

lines.en: : Chika, can you maybe, like...move your-
lines.zh: : Chika，你能不能……嗯……挪一下你的——

lines.en: scene secondcostumecontest26
: That’s not true at all. Rin and Otoha are actually really great together. You’ve just gotta get to know her a little better.
lines.zh: : 完全不是这样。Rin 和 Otoha 其实在一起很好。你只是需要多了解她一点。

lines.en: : Yeah, I’ve really only seen her the one time. But meanwhile, I know basically all there is to know about you after years of listening to Rin rave on and on and on and on...
lines.zh: : 是啊，我也就只见过她那一次。不过话说回来，听 Rin 这么多年天天念叨，关于你的事我基本全知道了。

lines.en: scene secondcostumecontest27
: Oh-ho-ho?
lines.zh: : 哦——嚯嚯？

lines.en: : Mom...can you please not?
lines.zh: : 妈……你能不能别说了？

lines.en: : Oh, it’s no big deal! The Chika era is behind you! Which means I can talk about that picture you kept of her on your vanity throughout all of middle school and no one will think it’s weird!
lines.zh: : 哦，这有什么大不了的！Chika 时代已经过去了！也就是说，我现在可以大谈你整个初中都把她的照片摆在梳妆台上，而没人会觉得奇怪！

lines.en: scene secondcostumecontest28
: Mom!
: Oh my God! That is freaking adorable!
lines.zh: : 我的天哪！这也太可爱了吧！

lines.en: : Right? You should have seen her blushing every time she said that you guys were just friends. She was so cute.
lines.zh: : 对吧？你是没看见，每次她说你们只是朋友时脸红的样子。她可爱死了。

lines.en: : Cut it out!
lines.zh: : 别说了！

lines.en: : No, no, no. Just another minute. I’m reminiscing.
lines.zh: : 不不不。再等一分钟。我在回忆往昔呢。

lines.en: scene secondcostumecontest29
: I can’t believe you kept it in for so long if your crush was really that huge. Were you waiting for a sign or something? You could have just told me.
lines.zh: : 我真不敢相信你能憋这么久——如果你的暗恋真的那么深的话。你是在等什么信号吗？你直接告诉我就好了。

lines.en: : Yeah. Who knows what would have happened if she found out a little earlier? You might even be with Chika instead of Otoha right now.
lines.zh: : 是啊。要是她早点发现会怎么样呢？说不定你现在跟 Chika 在一起，而不是 Otoha。

lines.en: scene secondcostumecontest30
: Heheh! Maybe! We’d make a cute couple, right? Just look at us.
lines.zh: : 呵呵！也许吧！我们俩会很配的，对吧？看看我们。

lines.en: : Totally. And you’re way more like the girls Rin usually-
lines.zh: : 当然。而且你更像 Rin 平常喜欢的那种女孩——

lines.en: scene secondcostumecontest31
: Uh-oh. I went too far, didn’t I?
lines.zh: : 哦豁。我说过头了，是吧？

lines.en: : Huh?
: Yes...you did.
lines.zh: : 是的……你说过头了。

lines.en: scene secondcostumecontest32
: Hey, I’m sorry. We were just messing around. I didn’t think that would hurt you.
lines.zh: : 嘿，对不起。我们只是闹着玩。我没想过那会伤到你。

lines.en: scene secondcostumecontest33
: Yeah, no one seems to have any idea what hurts me tonight. So I’m just going to go home as well.
lines.zh: : 是啊，今晚似乎没人知道什么会伤到我。所以我也干脆回家好了。

lines.en: : Rin, no. Stay with me. We can have fun together and forget things ever got weird.
lines.zh: : Rin，别走。留下来陪我。我们可以一起玩，把那些别扭的事忘掉。

lines.en: scene secondcostumecontest34
: Yeah, maybe you can! But you’re not the one being pulled in three different directions right now, Chika!
lines.zh: : 是啊，也许你可以！可现在被三股力量同时撕扯的人不是你，Chika！

lines.en: : All this is going to do is confuse me!
lines.zh: : 这一切只会让我更混乱！

lines.en: : Rin-
lines.zh: : Rin——

lines.en: : Let go!
lines.zh: : 放开！

lines.en: scene secondcostumecontest35
: Rin! Come on!
lines.zh: : Rin！别这样！

lines.en: : No! I’m going home to my prude of a girlfriend and yelling at her again! But thanks a lot to both of you for making tonight even worse than it already was!
lines.zh: : 不！我要回家去找我那个古板的女朋友，再冲她吼一顿！不过还是要好好谢谢你们俩，把今晚弄得比原本更糟！

lines.en: : Ahhh! Why do I always ruin everything?! Who put this stupid brain inside of my body?!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊！为什么我总是把一切都搞砸？！是谁把这颗蠢脑子塞进我身体里的？！

lines.en: : What happened with Rin? What’s going on?
lines.zh: : Rin 怎么了？发生什么事了？

lines.en: scene secondcostumecontest36
: What happened is I am a failure of a mother who-
lines.zh: : 发生的事就是，我这个当妈的彻底失败了，她——

lines.en: scene secondcostumecontest37
: Wait a minute. You’re that girl from the convenience store.
lines.zh: : 等等。你是便利店里那个女孩。

lines.en: : Haruka. Rin’s boss.
lines.zh: : Haruka。Rin 的老板。

lines.en: : I kind of assumed you were her mother based on...well, everything about you...but I figured we’d wind up meeting again soon enough.
lines.zh: : 我其实根据……嗯，你的一切……猜过你是她妈妈，不过我想我们迟早会再见的。

lines.en: : I didn’t think it would be like this, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我没想到会是以这种方式。

lines.en: scene secondcostumecontest38
: Ugh...me neither. But I also didn’t think I was ever going to see you again, so we’re not really the same.
lines.zh: : 呃……我也没想到。可我也从没想过还能再见到你，所以我们俩其实不太一样。

lines.en: : What should I do, Haruka? I keep making things worse for Rin and all I want to do is make her happy.
lines.zh: : 我该怎么办，Haruka？我一直把 Rin 的事情越弄越糟，可我只想让她幸福。

lines.en: : For now, I’d probably just...give her some time.
lines.zh: : 眼下，我大概会……先给她一点时间。

lines.en: : Chasing after her will only make her run that much faster.
lines.zh: : 追着她不放，只会让她跑得更快。

lines.en: scene secondcostumecontest39
: Hola, compadres! Ignoring the fact that Rika is too busy being a trainwreck to join us at the counter, I’d like to extend a hearty hello to those of you who were stable enough to make it tonight!
lines.zh: : 你好啊，老铁们！姑且不提 Rika 正忙着当一出灾难现场、没空来吧台这边，我要向今晚状态足够稳定、撑到现场的各位致以热烈的问候！

lines.en: : Just {i}barely{i} made it, I’ll add.
lines.zh: : 我补充一句，只是{i}勉强{/i}撑到而已。

lines.en: : But boy am I glad you did because this is a sight I would not mind waking up to every day for the rest of my life.
lines.zh: : 不过天哪，我真高兴你们来了，因为这幅景象，我余生每天醒来都能看到也心甘情愿。

lines.en: scene secondcostumecontest40
: Your surname isn’t “Takeda,” is it?
lines.zh: : 你的姓氏该不会是「Takeda」吧？

lines.en: : I sure hope not or I am absolutely {i}fucked{/i} when it comes to my taxes.
lines.zh: : 我当然希望不是，不然我报税的时候可就彻底{i}完蛋{/i}了。

lines.en: : Please excuse my partner for what I can sense is a rather angry expression she’s currently making.
lines.zh: : 请原谅我的伴侣——我能感觉到，她这会儿正摆出一副相当愤怒的表情。

lines.en: : Recent discussions may have implanted in her head the idea that I have been interested in sex with multiple women at the same time and, thus, she now likely believes I have enlisted you for that purpose.
lines.zh: : 最近的谈话可能在她脑子里植入了这样一个念头：我对同时与多名女性发生性关系感兴趣。因此，她现在大概认为我是为了这个目的才把你拉来的。

lines.en: : Enlisted? Is that why I keep being excluded from threesomes? Because I’m not signing the appropriate forms?
lines.zh: : 拉来？这就是为什么我总是被排除在三人行之外吗？因为我没有签相应的表格？

lines.en: scene secondcostumecontest41
: Despite what Wakana says and...what my expression {i}may{/i} have said...I’m not angry. Just tired. And also extremely embarrassed to be seen wearing this in public.
lines.zh: : 尽管 Wakana 是这么说的……还有我的表情{i}可能{/i}也传达了什么……但我并不生气。只是累了。而且穿着这身被别人看到，我尴尬得要命。

lines.en: : Why? You’re hot as hell.
lines.zh: : 为什么？你简直辣到爆。

lines.en: : Amen.
lines.zh: : 阿门。

lines.en: : Thanks, but there’s no way this sort of thing fits me.
lines.zh: : 谢谢，不过这种衣服穿在我身上肯定不合适。

lines.en: : I’m sure it comes as no surprise given my relationship, but I’ve always loved the style on other people. When it comes to myself, though...it just feels wrong. You know?
lines.zh: : 考虑到我的感情关系，这大概不出意料——我一直很喜欢别人穿这种风格。可放到我自己身上……就觉得不对劲。你懂吧？

lines.en: : Imani?
lines.zh: : Imani？

lines.en: : Hm? Sorry. Did you say something? I was thinking about our threesome later.
lines.zh: : 嗯？抱歉。你说什么了？我刚才在想我们待会儿的三人行。

lines.en: scene secondcostumecontest42
: Okay. {i}Now{/i} I’m angry.
lines.zh: : 好了。{i}现在{/i}我生气了。

lines.en: scene secondcostumecontest43
: Woah, Miku. What’s going on? Is it the noise? Do you need to step outside?
lines.zh: : 哇哦，Miku。怎么了？是声音太吵吗？要不要到外面去？

lines.en: scene secondcostumecontest44
: Makoto didn’t leave yet, did she? Maybe she-
lines.zh: : Makoto 还没走吧？也许她——

lines.en: : I can’t do it. I can’t go up there.
lines.zh: : 我不行。我上不去。

lines.en: scene secondcostumecontest43
: So...it’s not the noise? And what do you mean you can’t go up there? Why not?
lines.zh: : 所以……不是声音的问题？你说你上不去是什么意思？为什么？

lines.en: : This ain’t me. I ain’t cute...or stylish. Or pretty. And I got no idea what even half of what I’ve been sayin’ all weekend means.
lines.zh: : 这不是我。我不可爱……不时髦。也不漂亮。而且我连自己这整个周末说的话有一半是什么意思都不知道。

lines.en: : They’re gonna see through me. See that I don’t know how to do makeup or dress nice or talk without droppin’ letters and that I ain’t like them. I ain’t anything like them.
lines.zh: : 他们会看穿我的。会看出我不会化妆、不会穿搭、连说话都会掉字，还有我跟她们不一样。我跟她们一点都不一样。

lines.en: : Okay. Yeah. I get what you’re saying, but...counterpoint. Do you think Uta is {i}actually{/i} a kunoichi?
lines.zh: : 好吧。嗯，我懂你的意思，不过……反驳一下。你觉得 Uta {i}真的{/i}是女忍者吗？

lines.en: scene secondcostumecontest45

lines.zh: : 呃……不是吧？……

lines.en: : Remember what you’re doing. This is a {i}costume{/i} contest. No one is expecting you to actually {i}be{/i} this person.
lines.zh: : 记住你在做什么。这是{i}服装{/i}比赛。没人指望你真的{i}是{/i}这个人。

lines.en: : And stop biting your nails. You’re going to fuck them up.
lines.zh: : 还有别咬指甲了。你会把指甲咬坏的。

lines.en: : But...But I {i}have{/i} been this person since Friday. Why’s it all startin’ to crack now?
lines.zh: : 可是……可是我从周五开始就{i}一直{/i}是这个人了。为什么现在才开始崩？

lines.en: : Probably because Miku Maruyama hasn’t existed for 48 hours and she’s trying to break through again.
lines.zh: : 大概是因为 Miku Maruyama 已经四十八个小时不存在了，她正试图重新破壳而出。

lines.en: : You spent too long being someone else and that’s getting to you. But there’s nothing wrong with being someone else...and doing that doesn’t mean the {i}other{/i} you is gone forever.
lines.zh: : 你当别人当得太久，这开始反噬你了。但当别人并没有什么错……而且这么做也不代表{i}另一个{/i}你就永远消失了。

lines.en: : It just means you’ve gotta get better at controlling it so it takes longer for you to break next time.
lines.zh: : 这只意味着你得更好地控制它，好让下次崩溃来得更晚一些。

lines.en: : Why do I...have to break at all? Why can’t I just be who I wanna be?
lines.zh: : 为什么我……非得崩溃不可？为什么我就不能做我想做的人？

lines.en: : You can. But you wouldn’t have chosen such a hard costume and role if that's what you really wanted.
lines.zh: : 你可以啊。不过如果那真是你想要的，你就不会挑这么难的服装和角色了。

lines.en: scene secondcostumecontest46
: I can’t do it...I can’t do it...
lines.zh: : 我不行……我不行……

lines.en: : Miku, what’s wrong?! We’re gonna be starting any second now.
lines.zh: : Miku，怎么了？！我们马上就要开始了。

lines.en: : Do it without me. I can’t. I’m gonna lose. There ain’t no way.
lines.zh: : 别管我，你们上吧。我不行。我会输的。绝对不可能赢。

lines.en: : Textbook panic attack.
lines.zh: : 教科书式的惊恐发作。

lines.en: scene secondcostumecontest47
: Gee, thanks Io. There’s no way any of us would have been able to figure that out on our own.
lines.zh: : 谢了啊 Io。我们自己绝对看不出来。

lines.en: : Do you want my help or not? Because I’ve got pills for this and an excuse to get me the fuck out of here right now would be great.
lines.zh: : 你到底要不要我帮忙？我有药，而且我现在正缺一个能让我赶紧离开这鬼地方的借口。

lines.en: : You really think you’re going to be able to make it to the dorm and back in the next five minutes?
lines.zh: : 你真觉得自己能在五分钟内赶回宿舍再回来？

lines.en: : No. But I {i}would{/i} be able to make it to the coin locker around the corner.
lines.zh: : 不能。但我{i}能{/i}跑到拐角那个投币储物柜。

lines.en: : I made Io lock her pills up so she wouldn’t keep taking them all night long.
lines.zh: : 我让 Io 把她的药锁起来了，免得她整晚不停地吃。

lines.en: : And this is the perfect example of why I said that would be a bad idea. But we can argue about that later. How much does she weigh?
lines.zh: : 而这就是我说那是个坏主意的最佳例证。不过这个我们可以之后再吵。她多重？

lines.en: : She doesn’t need fucking pills! She needs to breathe.
lines.zh: : 她不需要什么该死的药！她需要的是呼吸。

lines.en: : She needs {i}both.{/i} But hey, if you want to want to risk throwing her up on that stage and making everything ten times worse, be my guest.
lines.zh: : 她{i}两个{/i}都需要。不过嘿，如果你想冒着把她推上台、让一切糟糕十倍的风险，请便。

lines.en: scene secondcostumecontest48
: Miku, what do you think? Do you want to try and tough this out? Or do you want some of Io’s medication?
lines.zh: : Miku，你觉得呢？你想硬撑过去？还是想吃一点 Io 的药？

lines.en: : M...Medication?
: I...I don’t know...I don’t usually take that kinda stuff...
lines.zh: : 我……我不知道……我平时不吃那种东西的……

lines.en: : Is it safe?...
lines.zh: : 安全吗？……

lines.en: : It’s Valium so side effects would include dizziness...drowsiness...nausea...memory loss...pretty much all the standard shit. But that’s all I’ve got for panic attacks in the locker.
lines.zh: : 是安定，所以副作用包括头晕……嗜睡……恶心……记忆丧失……基本就是那些标准玩意儿。不过我柜子里治惊恐发作的就只有这个了。

lines.en: : Anything else, I’d need to go back home.
lines.zh: : 别的药的话，我就得回家拿了。

lines.en: : Fine. Yeah. Go.
lines.zh: : 好。行。你去吧。

lines.en: : Are you {i}sure?{/i}
lines.zh: : 你{i}确定{/i}吗？

lines.en: : No.
lines.zh: : 不确定。

lines.en: : Just think of it like a painkiller but...for your brain. You’ve taken painkillers before, right?
lines.zh: : 就把它当成止痛药，不过是……给大脑用的。你以前吃过止痛药吧？

lines.en: : Yeah, but...
lines.zh: : 吃过，不过……

lines.en: scene secondcostumecontest49
: Attention, everyone! And let me start by saying thank you all very much for coming to the final stretch of the Dorm Wars!
lines.zh: : 各位请注意！首先，非常感谢大家来到宿舍大战的最后阶段！

lines.en: : Miss Imai! We-
lines.zh: : Imai 小姐！我们——

lines.en: : Don’t. Don’t say anything. Attention is bad. Keep it away.
lines.zh: : 别说。什么都别说。被注意到很糟。别让人注意到我。

lines.en: : Yes or no? Final answer.
lines.zh: : 要还是不要？最终答案。

lines.en: : Are you up first, Uta? Or is Miku supposed to go?
lines.zh: : 你是第一个上吗，Uta？还是该 Miku 先上？

lines.en: : I think Miku, but...
lines.zh: : 我觉得是 Miku，不过……

lines.en: scene secondcostumecontest50
: I’ll figure out a way to go first! And I’ll stall for as long as it takes.
lines.zh: : 我会想办法先上的！而且我会尽量拖时间，能拖多久拖多久。

lines.en: : Miku. Yes or no?
lines.zh: : Miku。要还是不要？

lines.en: : Yes. Yes yes yes. Go. Thank you.
lines.zh: : 要。要要要。去吧。谢谢。

lines.en: : Just painkillers for your brain. That sounds good. Really good.
lines.zh: : 就当是给大脑的止痛药。听起来不错。真的不错。

lines.en: : Just hang in there, okay?
lines.zh: : 撑住就好了，好吗？

lines.en: : It’ll all be over soon.
lines.zh: : 一切很快就会结束的。
